description: This file contains stress tests for Azure Table Storage data management, focusing on high-volume read/write operations and performance testing within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: AzureTableDataManagerStressTests
classes.description: A test class for performing stress tests on Azure Table Storage data management, including high-volume read/write operations.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManagerStressTests_WriteAlot_SinglePartition
methods.description: Performs a stress test writing a large number of entries to a single partition.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManagerStressTests_WriteAlot_MultiPartition
methods.description: Performs a stress test writing a large number of entries across multiple partitions.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManagerStressTests_ReadAll_SinglePartition
methods.description: Reads all entries from a single partition and measures performance.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManagerStressTests_ReadAllTableEntities
methods.description: Reads all table entries and then clears the table, measuring performance.

methods.name: WriteAlot_Async
methods.description: Helper method to perform bulk write operations with batching and timing.
